sources.title: Apache Kafka monitoring documentation for ISR shrink/expand and follower lag
KIP-497: Add inter-broker API to alter ISR

claims.text: Kafka trunk ReplicationConfigs defines replica.lag.time.max.ms with default 30000ms and documents leader removal of a follower from ISR when it has not sent fetch requests or consumed to the leader log end offset for at least that time.

Kafka ReplicaManager owns replica fetch handling and the ISR-expiration task, and its source comments describe follower fetch completion after successful replication from the leader. This supports the candidate's producer-to-leader append followed by follower-fetch replication chain without claiming an implementation-independent transport algorithm.

Kafka trunk TopicConfig documents min.insync.replicas including leader for acks=all/-1, all ISR acknowledgements for a successful acks=all write, failure when ISR is below the configured minimum, and consumer visibility after replication to ISR and satisfying min ISR.

Apache Kafka monitoring documentation exposes ISR shrink and expansion metrics and states that after a broker returns, ISR is expanded once replicas are fully caught up. KIP-497 records that leaders expand or shrink ISR as followers come in and out of sync. Together with the min-ISR write contract, this supports the candidate's operational statement that ISR churn can cause reject-write windows and recovery waiting while preserving the candidate's explicit decision not to specify an unmapped exact rejoin predicate.

KIP-497 treats ISR as a changing subset of replicas that the leader expands or shrinks based on synchronization state, while the candidate separately treats replication factor as the static replica count. This supports the answer's distinction between total replicas and currently in-sync replicas.

findings: 本轮先按候选源码断言重新核对 Kafka 上游配置、ReplicaManager、官方监控文档和 KIP-497，再回看前轮缺口；此前未映射的复制链路、ISR 动态收缩/扩展和恢复等待边界均已补齐一手来源。
候选继续明确 replica.lag.time.max.ms 的版本/配置边界、min.insync.replicas 与 acks=all 的组合语义，并明确不外推未逐项取证的精确重新加入判定。
唯一来源问法已完整覆盖，未发现事实无依据、版本无边界、题型错误或其他硬失败。
